title: Solution Consultant- Pre sales
description:
Responsibilities

Hexagon’s Asset Lifecycle Intelligence division (Hexagon) is seeking an Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Solution Consultant to join our growing solution consulting team (presales). The successful Solution Consultant (SC) provides total solution expertise to prospects and customers, largely supporting asset management software. The SC leads the solution discovery, design, configuration and then is the primary presenter during customer engagements that target specific industries and micro verticals. The SC uncovers the strategic objectives and business opportunities with the prospect’s stakeholders during discovery and understands the key metrics driving the solution evaluation. The SC coordinates with internal and external resources to ensure total solution strategy and a holistic solution approach.

  • Configure software and prepare other presentation materials for demonstrations
  • Showcase asset management solutions on desktop and mobile
  • Incorporate service offerings into the demonstration to provide a cohesive solution aligned with the prospect’s business needs
  • Demonstrate how system functional capabilities translate into business value and help prospects meet their own business objectives
  • Lead presentations that reinforce value at various audience levels, including executives and business users
  • Become a trusted adviser to customers and prospects by helping them understand how to meet their business goals
  • Maintain asset management industry, market, and competitor insights to support prospect inquiries during presentations
  • Respond to requests for proposals (RFPs) alongside Hexagon’s proposal team
  • Participate in building the Solution Consulting community through teamwork, building relevant data sets and examples, creating compelling presentation material and sharing industry knowledge
  • Remain current on new product releases and maintain demo environments as required
  • Understand capabilities of other Hexagon solutions to identify capabilities, products, services to grow the opportunity footprint with sales leaders
  • Participate in tradeshows, user conferences, and sales seminars as required
  • Conduct timely and accurate internal reporting such as effort tracking and documentation of interactions with customers and prospects
Education / Qualifications
  • Bachelor of Science in Engineering or Computer Science or related is highly desired
  • Ability to articulate integration capabilities, interoperability, and typical data flows
  • Enterprise software consulting, implementations or maintenance management experience is required, minimum 4 years
  • Knowledgeable of solution delivery strategies such as on-premise, SaaS, and the high level benefits of each
  • Travel to customer and prospect sites as required (45-55% travel) for discovery, solution presentations, workshops, and conferences
  • Experience presenting to various audience sizes and various levels in the organization to include C-level audiences
  • Languages – English
Preferred
  • Experience with EAM solutions
  • Demo2Win Certified
  • On-hand industry experience with asset management
  • Languages – Spanish, Portuguese
  • Knowledge of asset management strategies, asset reliability, data integrations, supply chain, asset performance management, or other advanced asset management topics
  • Knowledge of programming languages – Python, SQL, JavaScript
  • Experience selling solutions, ideas, or initiatives

LI-Remote

About Hexagon

Hexagon is a global leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software and autonomous technologies. We are putting data to work to boost efficiency, productivity, quality and safety across industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure, public sector, and mobility applications.

Hexagon’s Asset Lifecycle Intelligence division helps clients design, construct, and operate more profitable, safe, and sustainable industrial facilities. We empower customers to unlock data, accelerate industrial project modernization and digital maturity, increase productivity, and move the sustainability needle.

Our technologies help produce actionable insights that enable better decision‑making and intelligence across the asset lifecycle of industrial projects, leading to improvements in safety, quality, efficiency, and productivity, which contribute to economic and environmental sustainability.

Hexagon (Nasdaq Stockholm: HEXA) has approximately 25,000 employees in 50 countries and net sales of approximately 5.4 bn EUR. Learn more at hexagon.com and follow us @HexagonAB.

Why work for Hexagon?

At Hexagon, if you can see it, you can do it. Hexagon’s Asset Lifecycle Intelligence division puts their trust in you so that you can bring your ideas to life. We have emerged as one of the most engaged and enabled workplaces. We are committed to creating an environment that is truly supportive by providing the resources you need to fully support your ambitions, no matter who you are or where you are in the world.

  • In the recently concluded workplace effectiveness survey by Korn Ferry, a global HR advisory firm, Hexagon, Asset Lifecycle Intelligence division has emerged as one of the most Engaged and Enabled workplaces, when compared to similar organizations that Korn Ferry partners with.
Everyone is welcome

At Hexagon, we believe that diverse and inclusive teams are critical to the success of our people and our business. Everyone is welcome—as an inclusive workplace, we do not discriminate. In fact, we embrace differences and are fully committed to creating equal opportunities, an inclusive environment, and fairness for all.

Respect is the cornerstone of how we operate, so speak up and be yourself. You are valued here.

Job description

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.


Main responsibilities

Se você é uma pessoa organizada , com visão estratégica e que se motiva por transformação , essa é a sua oportunidade. Nesta posição de Especialista PMO , você terá o papel central de garantir a execução e o sucesso dos projetos mais importantes e transformadores da companhia, sendo a ponte entre a operação e o C-level. Seu trabalho será essencial para traduzir a estratégia em ação e resultados concretos.

No dia a dia você vai:

  • Gerir o portfólio de Projetos Estratégicos: Responsável pela priorização, planejamento, acompanhamento e controle de projetos de alta complexidade e impacto na companhia, garantindo que estejam alinhados à estratégia de negócio.
  • Monitoramento e Reporte de Performance: Desenvolver e manter um sistema robusto de indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) para os projetos, preparando reports de status e análises de risco de forma clara e objetiva para apresentação direta ao C-level (Diretoria e Presidência).
  • Garantia da Execução: Atuar como um facilitador e agente de mudança, identificando e removendo impedimentos, gerenciando dependências e mitigando riscos que possam comprometer os prazos e o escopo dos projetos.
  • Governança de Projetos: Estabelecer e manter os padrões de metodologia, processos e ferramentas de gestão de projetos (PMO Framework) para garantir consistência e qualidade na execução dos projetos da companhia.
  • Comunicação e Engajamento: Ser o ponto focal e garantir a comunicação fluida e eficaz entre os diversos stakeholders envolvidos, desde as equipes operacionais até a alta liderança.
  • Suporte à Tomada de Decisão: Fornecer dados e insights de progresso e performance dos projetos para subsidiar decisões estratégicas da liderança executiva.

Requirements and skills

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência Comprovada em PMO ou Gestão de Projetos: Sólida experiência na gestão de portfólio e/ou programas de projetos transformacionais em empresas de médio ou grande porte.
  • Experiência com Alto Nível de Exposição: Histórico de sucesso em acompanhamento, comunicação e reporte de projetos diretamente para C-level e alta gestão.
  • Conhecimento em Metodologias de Projetos: Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática em metodologias de gestão de projetos (e.g., PMBOK, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum, OKR).
  • Análise de Dados e KPIs: Habilidade avançada em análise de dados, métricas de projeto (e.g., Earned Value, Burn Rate) e elaboração de dashboards e relatórios executivos.
  • Ensino Superior Completo: Preferencialmente em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação será um diferencial.
  • Habilidades Interpessoais: Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, capacidade de negociação, influência e resiliência para lidar com ambientes de alta pressão e stakeholders diversos.

Será considerado como um diferencial:

  • Certificação PMP (Project Management Professional) ou similar (e.g., ACP, PSM).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de portfólio (e.g., MS Project, Trello, Jira, Asana, Clarizen).
  • Experiência em empresas com atuação em negócios digitais ou em projetos de transformação digital .
  • Inglês Fluente: Essencial para comunicação e documentação.

Additional information

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

description:
Job description

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Porque somos a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão em prática fazendo a diferença nos 178 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 26 milhões de pessoas. Somos inspirados a transformar o futuro e melhorar a forma que as pessoas vivem. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

A partir de 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

title: Associate Director of Creative, AI
description:
Join to apply for the Associate Director of Creative, AI role at Darkroom .

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next‑generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive‑level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e‑commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Thanks to our proprietary data infrastructure, we accelerate growth, improve margins, and compound results across our client portfolio.

Darkroom has evolved from a boutique design studio to one of the fastest‑growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising.

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Associate Director of Creative who will act as a player/coach, leading a pod of designers and delivering AI‑powered creative direction, marketing design, and UI/UX projects. The role requires deep experience in integrating AI tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Midjourney to drive creative efficiency and quality.

Reporting to the Director of Creative, you will advocate for design processes and supervise junior designers across paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. Your first 60 days will focus on integrating ChatGPT and AI into the creative workflow and building training programs.

Management Responsibilities
  • Manage a team of designers, initially 1–2 direct reports, providing strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and escalation handling.
  • Conduct weekly one‑on‑ones to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high‑quality output, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and deadlines.
  • Collaborate with marketers, strategists, developers, and clients to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.
  • Refine internal client work processes in coordination with the Director of Creative and provide training and feedback.
Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities
  • Champion AI‑powered work, leading trainings on best practices and building efficient workflows with the Director of Creative.
  • Lead creative direction engagements that transform paid or organic marketing channels with deliverables such as content calendars, creative briefs, and strategic proposals.
  • Lead 1–2 UI/UX engagements focused on branded e‑commerce websites, emphasizing conversion‑focused UX and clarity.
  • Present design and creative direction work to clients, explaining choices based on UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.
You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You
  • 3–6+ years of senior‑level design experience, with at least 1 year of people‑management experience preferred; experience in creative direction, marketing design, or responsive web design.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web, marketing, and branding skills; color theory, hierarchy, composition, typography.
  • Self‑motivated, proactive, detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience working with AI tools and producing client‑ready assets powered by AI outputs (required).
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for hand‑off.
  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving feedback.
  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, design solutions, and execute effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma (Auto Layout, Components, Variants) essential.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) required.
Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is built for A‑players. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring rigor. We hold a high bar for performance but support each other relentlessly.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in business, you’ll thrive here.

Remote‑First Culture
  • Live remote; employees in New York or Lisbon (opening 2026) adopt hybrid with weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations include Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental leave: flexible benefits to support new parents.
  • Endless growth opportunities: cross‑functional collaboration beyond job description.

Location: fully remote (EST timezone); open to Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal‑opportunity workplace—dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Auxilia no processo de treinamento e desenvolvimento dos colaboradores (loja e logística) para uso dos recursos e aderência aos processos de movimentação e armazenagem de material.
  • Representa papel central na luta anti demarca e apresenta relatórios de maior profundidade durante as reuniões de briefing e, é um modelo de eficácia no contra poder e na adoção de boas práticas.

Senior Software Engineer, Fund Operations The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As a Senior Software Engineer I or Senior Software Engineer II , you’ll work to solve problems like:

  • How can we leverage the power of AI to create exceptional, seamless experiences for our customers?
  • How can we design reliable systems for tracking capital movement across a fund’s lifecycle, from initial call to final distribution?
  • How do we build flexible reporting pipelines that adapt to evolving fund structures and support compliance with financial regulations?
  • How can we apply machine learning to automate workflows traditionally powered by spreadsheets and manual reviews?
The Team You’ll Work With

Carta’s Fund Operations Engineering Organization is designing the infrastructure that redefines how investment firms across Venture Capital and Private Equity run. We’re building the systems that sit at the heart of fund administration: financial data pipelines, transaction engines, ML-assisted tooling, and full-service automation.

Our teams are multidisciplinary, working closely with product leaders, accountants, data scientists, and ML researchers to take on some of Carta’s most challenging, ambiguous problems. We’re drawn to complexity, motivated by clarity, and operate with a high degree of ownership. If you thrive in early innings problems, enjoy building clean abstractions from messy, real-world scenarios, and want to help shape an industry-standard platform from the ground up, this is the place to do it.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 6+ years of experience of full-stack or backend engineering experience
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator
  • You act as an owner, not just a contributor, by taking responsibility for outcomes, pushing through ambiguity, and championing solutions that improve team efficiency and business impact.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and stand the test of time.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.

title: Analista de Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
  • Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;
  • Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
  • Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
  • Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
  • Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.
  • Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
  • Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas fiscais e ERPs SAP Diferencial.

O Que Temos Para Você

  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Wellhub;
  • Acolhe (serviço de apoio psicossocial);

Local de Trabalho: Escritórios Corporativos Tijuca e Leblon - RJ

A mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Existimos para conectar as pessoas com o que importa, servindo e encantando todos os dias e criando momentos que transformam.

Em um mundo em constante evolução, emergimos como uma poderosa força de transformação. Um legado com cerca de 50 anos de experiência que transformou o varejo no Brasil e consolidou uma trajetória de excelência e confiança, estabelecendo-nos como referência no mercado, com um portfólio de 59 shoppings presentes nas cinco regiões do Brasil.

Nossos shoppings são destinos vibrantes, repletos de oportunidades para empreendedores e marcas inovadoras. Com mais de 15.000 lojas que atraem mais de 54 milhões de visitas por mês, criamos espaços acolhedores, seguros e inspiradores, onde cada visita se torna uma jornada de descoberta e conexão.

Criamos experiências físicas e digitais que transcendem as expectativas dos consumidores e geram impacto positivo na sociedade, com visão de longo prazo e resultados sustentáveis para lojistas e parceiros.

DIVERSIDADE, EQUIDADE E INCLUSÃO

A ALLOS está comprometida com a criação e fomento de um ambiente de trabalho diverso, que acolha pessoas de raças, etnias, gêneros, origens, vivências e perfis variados, priorizando a inclusão social, a redução das desigualdades e práticas empregatícias justas, que promovam a igualdade de oportunidades.

Esperamos que todos os colaboradores, de qualquer cargo ou hierarquia, sintam-se acolhidos e se orientem pelo respeito mútuo.

As nossas vagas são destinadas para pessoas de diferentes grupos, incluindo mulheres, pessoas negras, LGBTQIAPN+, pessoas com deficiência ou demais grupos sub-representados.

A Stone

A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros, focada no cliente e na transformação da indústria de pagamentos para apoiar o empreendedorismo brasileiro. Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades.

Nossa Cultura
  • Own It : Espírito de dono traz liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e buscamos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
  • Live the Ride : Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com erros e vemos desafios como oportunidades de crescimento.
  • No Bullshit : Agimos com simplicidade. Somos práticos, sinceros e valorizamos feedbacks, usando transparência para evol, mesmo em erros.
  • Team Play : Quer ir rápido? Vá sozinho(a). Quer ir longe? Vá em equipe. Aprendemos uns com os outros, e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  • The Reason : O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos impactá-lo positivamente e ver as melhorias que trazemos à sua vida.
Gerente de Relacionamento de Crédito Stone

Sua missão vai muito além da simples oferta de crédito. Você será o principal parceiro estratégico dos empreendedores mais influentes da sua região, realizando um diagnóstico financeiro profundo de cada negócio. Com base nessa análise, você desenhará e implementará estratégias de crédito personalizadas, integrando-as a um ecossistema completo de soluções Stone em finanças, software e gestão. Seu objetivo é garantir não apenas a melhor solução de crédito, mas uma experiência de excelência que impulsione de forma decisiva o sucesso e a competitividade dos nossos clientes.

Como será seu dia a dia
  • Rotina híbrida com reuniões presenciais e online;
  • Estabelecer contato com clientes para oferecer soluções de crédito adequadas;
  • Conduzir negociações e construir relacionamentos sólidos com os clientes;
  • Gerenciar e expandir a carteira de clientes, assegurando a satisfação e a retenção;
  • Realizar visitas comerciais para prospecção de novos clientes e manutenção de relacionamentos;
  • Realizar análises da capacidade de pagamento dos clientes com rigor, assegurando decisões de crédito informadas e seguras.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Sólido conhecimento em produtos de crédito e no setor financeiro;
  • Experiência em riscos de crédito na concessão de crédito e matemática financeira;
  • Habilidade em negociação e gestão de carteira;
  • Conhecimento do mercado regional e experiência em vendas;
  • Capacidade de interpretar e aplicar políticas de crédito de forma clara.

Somos a Âmbar, a empresa de geração e comercialização de energia do grupo J&F, o maior grupo privado do Brasil. Nosso amplo portfólio de ativos contribui para a expansão e diversificação da matriz energética do Brasil.

Respaldados pela solidez do grupo J&F, atuamos na comercialização de energia no Mercado Livre e em projetos de Geração Distribuída para clientes em todo o Brasil. Atuamos na gestão completa das contas, criando soluções personalizadas para consumidores e empresas de todos os portes.

Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities, movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managing the entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un‑/loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE‑ and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health‑and‑safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post‑tournaments
YOUR PROFILE
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast‑paced, multi‑level, project‑based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro

title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
Medical Science Liaison

Location: Rio de Janeiro / Belo Horizonte

Field-based work model

At Sanofi, we are driven by one purpose – we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible.

We never settle and now we are creating a new paradigm with a first-in-class therapy in Autoimmune Diabetes (Type 1 Diabetes).

Our newest core asset, resulting from the acquisition of Prevention Bio in General Medicines Autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes space, aims at delaying the onset of stage 3 type 1 diabetes. This means that for the first time, people at risk of developing this lifelong disease have fresh hope. What delayed onset means is more time for children to be children with less healthcare and more care-free childhood. The delay also gives families and healthcare professionals more time to prepare care plans for a later diagnosis.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and visionary scientific leader to serve as a MSL with expertise in T1D. This role combines deep scientific expertise with strategic thinking to enhance the identification and management of people at risk of developing T1D, emphasizing the benefits of early detection and the use of new immunomodulators.

As a MSL - Autoimmune T1D Specialist, you will be the trusted scientific partner for external experts and decision-makers, while also contributing to the development and implementation of screening and monitoring strategies as well as engaging with experts in new therapies such as immunomodulators. This dual focus position will drive both scientific exchange and strategic initiatives to improve early identification and management of T1D.

Main responsibilities Scientific Leadership & KOL Engagement
  • Serve as trusted scientific partner to key external experts (including KOLs, endocrinologists, pediatricians, and other scientific stakeholders), establishing and maintaining robust, long-term peer relationships
  • Conduct high-touch scientific exchange with experts from Centers of Excellence and beyond to convey a compelling and highly scientific narrative on T1D disease stages, importance of screening and treatment
  • Engage with experts to share scientific data, answer product-specific questions, and support them in developing best practices (e.g., infusion protocols)
  • Link internal partners to external thought leaders for education and research collaboration
  • Disseminate innovative medical education materials and foster medical/scientific information exchange within the medical community
  • Tailor engagement to different stakeholder segments based on comprehensive stakeholder mapping and local go-to-market model

Early Detection Strategy

Strategic Implementation

  • Coordinate and direct requests for ISS, RCT, Managed Access Programs to appropriate teams
  • Keep up-to-date on medical and scientific developments in the Type 1 Diabetes field
Individual Contributors

  • Comply with and promote Sanofi's Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies, with the objective of preventing accidents, avoiding health risks, promoting employee well-being, and reducing environmental impacts resulting from work activities.
  • Support Sanofi's Diversity and Inclusion strategy and initiatives to ensure that all employees and partners are treated with respect and receive equal opportunities.
About you Experience
  • Minimum 3 years experience as MSL in Specialty / Rare disease / Type 1 Diabetes area
  • Experience in T1D or immunology highly preferred
  • Background in clinical research or academic setting
  • Experience with population health initiatives or screening programs is a plus

  • Strategic thinking.

  • Interpersonal relationship.
  • Transversal collaboration.
  • Learning agility.
  • Ability to build proper environment to enable Playing to Win culture to flourish.
Professional competencies

  • Excellence in scientific communication and presentation
  • Strategic thinking and ability to translate science into actionable insights
  • Strong collaboration skills for cross-functional teamwork
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders
  • Project management capabilities

  • Additional training in public health or population health management preferred
Language

Advanced English required.

Why should you choose us?
  • Be part of a purpose-driven organization that pursues the miracles of science to improve people’s lives worldwide
  • Access comprehensive benefits including health insurance, life insurance, and pension plans aligned with market best practices
  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements that support work-life integration and well-being
  • Benefit from continuous learning and development opportunities through Sanofi University and specialized training programs
  • Be part of building a new concept in autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes by bringing early detection and the use of new immunomodulators capable of changing the course of the disease.
  • Join Brazil’s largest and fastest-growing immunology franchise, playing a key role in the growth strategy and market leadership

Progress wouldn’t be possible without people; people from different backgrounds, in different locations, performing different roles, but all united by a common goal: the desire to make miracles happen. You can become one of these people. Seek change, embrace new ideas, and explore all the opportunities we have to offer. Pursue progress and discover the extraordinary with us.

title: Security Software Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is looking for exceptional security‑focused software engineers to be integrated across product teams. While they also contribute to the product as engineers, their primary focus is to challenge the entire team to think more deeply about security through state‑of‑the‑art practices such as threat modeling, table‑top exercises, architecture and design reviews, static analysis tools, and fuzzing, among others.

These roles encompass all aspects of product security, including feature development, vulnerability response, proactive security, and open‑source community participation. Engineers in these roles collaborate closely with other Canonical teams, customers, and partners across the open‑source ecosystem.

Each product engineering team at Canonical reserves one or two openings for security‑oriented software engineers. We also develop a number of products driven entirely by security needs, such as our AppArmor kernel investments and the Ubuntu Security Guide (USG). As the publisher of Ubuntu, we also handle long‑term security response for the entire operating system and open‑source ecosystem. Working with tens of thousands of upstreams means that we need to be fluent in every major programming language and design, build, and adopt sophisticated tools that enable us to work at scale and speed with confidence.

Apply here if you are an exceptional security‑focused software engineer, passionate about open source, and excited by Canonical's products and mission.

This role requires the ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through strong self‑discipline and motivation. It also involves mandatory international travel at least twice a year, typically for one week.

Location: Worldwide, this is a globally remote role.

What you'll do
  • Define, implement, and document new security features
  • Lead security‑focused initiatives within a product engineering team
  • Analyze, fix, and test vulnerabilities in open source software
  • Contribute to Ubuntu and upstream open source projects to benefit the community
  • Audit and analyze source code for vulnerabilities
  • Integrate new tools into our security infrastructure, pipelines, and processes
  • Achieve and retain various security certifications
  • Extend and enhance Linux cryptographic components to meet country‑specific compliance requirements, such as FIPS and Common Criteria (CC) certifications
  • Work with external partners to develop Center for Internet Security (CIS) benchmarks
  • Design and develop hardening automation for Ubuntu
  • Stay up to date with trends and developments in the security industry
  • Develop, test, and maintain new software capabilities
  • Provide guidance and support to other engineering teams on security best practices
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • A track record of going above and beyond expectations
  • Thorough understanding of the common categories of security vulnerabilities and how to fix them
  • Knowledge of modern software engineering techniques
  • Familiarity with open source development tools and methodologies
  • Skill in one or more of C, C++, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Ruby, PHP, or JavaScript/Typescript
  • Experience as a security champion
  • Experience driving security within a wider SSDLC process
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self‑motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Results‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
Optional skills we also value
  • Clear and effective communication with both the team and Ubuntu community members
  • Experience working with the Linux kernel
  • Experience with security certifications and knowledge of FIPS and/or Common Criteria (CC)
  • Experience with OVAL (Open Vulnerability Assessment Language)
  • Knowledge of cryptographic modules such as OpenSSL and Libgcrypt
  • Knowledge of low‑level Linux cryptography APIs
  • Demonstrated ability to learn quickly
  • Performance engineering experience
What we offer you
  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence — in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Analista de Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Company Description

Fairmont Hotels is a globally renowned luxury brand, celebrated for creating unforgettable memories for our guests. With more than 30,000 colleagues worldwide, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional service, embracing innovation, and fostering a culture of excellence.

Hotel Overview

Perched on the world-famous Copacabana Beach, the Fairmont Copacabana is one of Rio de Janeiro’s most prestigious luxury addresses and a symbol of city’s glamorous lifestyle. With 375 rooms and suites, many offering panoramic views of the ocean and Sugar Loaf Mountain, the hotel blends timeless elegance with the vibrant energy of Rio.

As a leading destination for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel boasts extensive meeting and event spaces, hosting everything from high-profile international conferences to glamorous weddings and social gatherings. With its enviable beachfront location, modern design infused with local culture, and a legacy of warm Brazilian hospitality, the Fairmont Copacabana embodies the art de vivre of Fairmont while standing as an icon of Rio de Janeiro’s luxury hotel scene.

Job Description

As the General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana , you will embody the essence of luxury hospitality. Your dynamic and hands‑on approach is fueled by a deep passion for developing people and fostering an entrepreneurial spirit. A true brand and guest ambassador, you will challenge conventions, consistently seek solutions, and infuse innovation into every facet of the hotel experience and every function of the business.

Your seasoned leadership style will blend diplomacy with relationship‑building prowess, cultivating strong connections with both internal and external stakeholders, including Owners and the Community. description:
Senior Software Engineer I, Integrations The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta’s long‑term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer‑facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third‑party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event‑driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You’ll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we’re building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript and any backend language.
  • You may be familiar with some additional elements of the Carta tech stack (Python, Django, React, Postgres, gRPC, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS).

The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list). Finally, you'll have back‑to‑back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

  • Building customer‑facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third‑party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event‑driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You’ll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we’re building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript and any backend language
  • You may be familiar with some additional elements of the Carta tech stack (Python, Django, React, Postgres, GRPC, Kafka, docker, K8, AWS)
The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list). Finally, you'll have back‑to‑back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.
